name: component-performance-values
goal: Collect truthful latency and memory observations for every component with a representative measured workload, and improve Harness guidance so component and route evidence retain correct boundaries and unavailable values stay explicit.

evidence: At origin/main 54e157c42845945bb1fc1fa4e802d96983f7e584, the catalog has 181 kind=component units; 57 declare scenarios and all 181 have empty performance budgets. The existing page benchmark records whole Explorer route navigation and whole-page heap, including shared code, and cannot populate component-level metrics. Acceptance: inventory every component; record only measured component workloads with exact revision, target, profile, boundary, samples and provenance; retain an explicit unavailable reason where a representative workload or safe memory attribution is absent; improve the Harness measurement guidance and verify all changed instructions/tests.
